title: Image Layout Manager
description:
Image Layout Manager is a desktop application for composing multi-panel academic figures: grid and freeform layouts, automatic panel labels, text-size matching across SVG and raster panels, a built-in plot editor, and export to PDF, PNG, TIFF and SVG.

AI use: developed with the AI coding assistant Devin (Cognition) for code generation and documentation. All code and documentation were reviewed and are maintained by the author, who takes full responsibility for the software.
